_about: Cutouts that must not ship: an AI render with garbled or wrong lettering, a product that is not what its name says, a subject cut off at the frame, or a broken render. Found 2026-09-27 by OCR over every cutout (RapidOCR) and by eye over every cutout a live template uses. scripts/audit_templates.mjs and audit_showcase_content.mjs hold back any card that draws one (defect 'asset'); offer-library.js never uses them.
gold-bars-row: bars stamped BOLD instead of GOLD
silver-bar-single: a silver bar stamped WILD GOLD

iphone-16-back-teal: not an iPhone: a triple camera strip on the edge, no Apple logo
iphone-floating-tilt: not an iPhone: an Android camera strip

iphone-hand-hold: a wavy edge where a hand was cut away
